claims.citation: New York Herald, 1 May 1866, p. 5, col. 1
claims.verbatim:
The steamship Hibernian, from Liverpool on Thurs-
day, April 19, via Londonderry April 20, passed Father
Point yesterday evening, en route to Quebec.
The news by the Hibernian is two days later than the
report of the Allemania, which appeared in the HERALD
yesterday morning, soon after the arrival of the vessel
at this port.
